strategy.summary: The strategy for the TeamMates project focuses on developing an all-in-one platform for sports teams, incorporating features such as scheduling, communication, and payments. The project aims to finalize its mobile app and web platform, launch a registration dashboard, and introduce premium features while leveraging proven technologies like Flutter and AWS. Additionally, the project is supported by Kickstarter funding to enhance system performance and stability.
